Archive fixtures in this directory are from the MIT-licensed libarchive-wasm
project: https://github.com/ofk/libarchive-wasm/tree/main/archives
Retrieved 2026-10-06. The upstream license is included alongside these files.

They contain a small example README, image and symbolic link. Tests read the
archives in memory and never follow or extract the link. Encrypted samples use
the upstream fixture password `Passw0rd!`; no real credentials are included.
